name: Intake handles the application
description: An Intake employee submits the application and then checks its documents.

name: Parallel credit assessment
description: After Intake has checked the documents, Credit checks the credit and verifies the income in parallel, and then decides.
edges: Check-documents_Intake -> Check-credit_Credit; Check-documents_Intake -> Verify-income_Credit; Check-credit_Credit -> Decide_Credit; Verify-income_Credit -> Decide_Credit

name: Offer handling
description: After a positive decision by Credit, the Offers department creates and sends the offer.

name: Closing by the back office
description: After the offer is sent, the BackOffice signs the contract and archives the application.

name: Denial handed back to Intake
description: Credit denies the application and Intake notifies the customer.
